title.en-US: Common Word Order in the World's Languages

prompt.zh-CN: 从语言数量上看，世界上占比最多的基本语序类型是哪一种？
prompt.en-US: By number of languages, which basic word order is most common in the world?

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 SOV，即主语-宾语-谓语。按语言数量统计，SOV 通常被认为最多，SVO 次之。
reveal.en-US: The answer is SOV, Subject-Object-Verb. By number of languages, SOV is usually counted as the most common type, with SVO next.

prompt.zh-CN: 玛雅文字通常如何排列和阅读？
prompt.en-US: How is Maya writing usually arranged and read?

text.en-US: Left to right, line by line
Right to left, column by column

text.zh-CN: 成对列组，从左到右、组内自上而下阅读
text.en-US: In paired columns, moving left to right, top to bottom within each pair

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 D。玛雅文字常按成对列组阅读：先读左侧两列的一组，再往右移动。
reveal.en-US: The answer is D. Maya texts are commonly read in paired columns, proceeding through a left pair before moving rightward.
